summary: Eupraxia Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K on July 7, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing the appointment of three new independent directors (Robert Bazemore, Amy Pott, Dr. Helen Thackray) to its board of directors, alongside acknowledgments to outgoing directors. No deal terms, acquisition, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation activity is mentioned. This is a routine corporate governance update for a foreign private issuer. No price, premium, stake percentage, or strategic review is disclosed. There is no event triggering a special-situations classification beyond a standard board composition change, which does not constitute a forced or abrupt management departure.
